monitor.investigationsNote: Dossiers are stored in local SQLite with either the daemon or embedded monitor.

overview.title: System health
overview.diagnosticsCompleteNone: Analysis complete: no active findings with current rules.
overview.diagnosticsCompleteSome: Analysis complete: see active findings below.
overview.noFakeScore: Status is derived from live telemetry, not a fabricated health percentage.
overview.noneYet: No diagnoses yet — diagnostic engine arrives in Phase 2.
overview.noneActive: No active findings — rules run on each telemetry sample.
overview.noIncidents: Black Box recording starts in Phase 3.
overview.activityHint: Last ~60 samples (~1 s). Axis labels adapt to avoid overlap.
overview.activityProfile: Current activity profile: {{name}}. See Profiles for details.
overview.blackboxLink: Open Black Box for recorded diagnostic incidents.

profiles.title: Activity profiles
profiles.subtitle: Heimdall infers how you use the machine. You can override app associations.
profiles.noSignals: Not enough signals yet — keep using the machine with Heimdall open.
profiles.overrideHint: Partial process name (e.g. steam, cursor, blender).
profiles.baselineLearning: Collecting samples to estimate what is typical for this profile.
profiles.baselineInsufficient: Insufficient data for a reliable baseline on this profile.

blackbox.title: Black Box
blackbox.subtitle: Local telemetry and incident log. No invented causes without evidence.
blackbox.investigationsLink: To reconstruct a process that already exited (e.g. intermittent bursts), open Investigations — this view is for automatic diagnostic incidents only.
blackbox.selectIncident: Select an incident to view the timeline.

processes.title: Processes
processes.subtitle: Top by CPU and memory (point-in-time sample, not full history).
processes.memoryHint: Memory is per-process resident RSS (sysinfo). Shared pages may appear in multiple rows; do not sum rows as exclusive total usage.

intelligence.title: Intelligence
intelligence.subtitle: Evidence-first rules; optional local assistant via Ollama.
intelligence.none: No active findings match the configured rules right now.
intelligence.assistantHint: Optional. Without Ollama, Heimdall still shows deterministic diagnostics.
intelligence.question: Question
intelligence.ollamaUnreachable: Could not reach Ollama. Check that the service is running and the URL in Settings.
intelligence.ollamaErrorDetail: Could not complete the assistant request.

investigations.title: Investigation Center
investigations.subtitle: Deterministic dossiers rebuilt from historical telemetry. You can explore processes that have already exited.
investigations.anomalyDisclaimer: An anomaly describes activity deviation; it does not imply malware or a security threat on its own.
investigations.select: Select a dossier from the list.
investigations.replayEmpty: No timeline points in this dossier.
investigations.aiDisclaimer: AI does not modify evidence or raise attribution confidence.
